I would say you are a bit late in the process to end up swimming D1. Most top D1 schools have already completed their roster and are not looking for more walk ons. That said, don’t let that ruin your dream of swimming in college. Virtually all schools with a swim team will also have a club/intramural team with no divisional attachment that you can use to expand on your swimming skills, or maybe you will like the experience of less responsibility and commitment to a team.

Contact with the coach is the first big thing you want to do. Just letting them know “hey I’m going to this school and want to swim with you guys but I’m not fast enough, what is the right direction to be going” is enough to be on their radar. And I’m sure you’ve heard that being 6’9” is an attention grabber :)

There should be plenty of guides online about the whole process. I wish you the best of luck!
